videos.title: The Claude You Can't Use | Broski Talk Ep. 1
videos.description:
There's a version of Claude that's better than the one you pay for, and you can't use it. Mark Santos and Simon Dziak bring Broski Talk back as an AI podcast and break down the week: METR's look inside Anthropic, Claude asking for your bank account, the AI assistant wars, the voter backlash against AI data centers, free frontier models, and one guy who paid $681 for a 25-second AI video.

Which one cost $681: A, B, C or D? Comment your guess before the reveal.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Which one cost $681?
0:50 Claude's secret models (METR, AI building AI)
3:09 Claude wants your wallet
5:21 The AI assistant wars
8:04 The AI backlash
12:33 Free frontier models
14:44 Builder's corner
16:23 Predictions

THE 12 AGENT SKILLS (from Builder's corner)
1. gstack by Garry Tan: your agent as CEO, tech lead, designer and QA: https://github.com/garrytan/gstack
2. Superpowers: plan, test, debug and review like a senior engineer: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
3. Taste Skill: better layouts, type and animation: https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill
4. UI/UX Pro Max: palettes, font pairings and clean UI: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
5. Marketing Skills: copy, SEO, pricing and launches: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
6. Last 30 Days: research reports from the last month of Reddit, X and more: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill
7. Frontend Slides: pitch decks you share as a link or PDF: https://github.com/zarazhangrui/frontend-slides
8. No AI Slop: makes your writing sound human: https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop
9. Brag: launch and demo videos of what you built: https://github.com/latent-spaces/brag
10. Claude for Legal: Anthropic's plugins for contracts and NDAs: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-for-legal
11. Caveman: shorter replies, about 65% fewer tokens: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman
12. Awesome Claude Skills: a curated list of even more: https://github.com/ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
List via Launch Llama: https://x.com/launch_llama/status/2118100994726773075

videos.title: Elon Never Said That | Broski Talk Ep. 2
videos.description:
1.5 million people watched Elon Musk explain that you're using AI wrong. He never said it. Mark Santos and Simon Dziak went through the whole 47-minute Grok 4 launch stream to find what was actually said, and why the fake advice might still be right. Then the week: a tier list that puts Claude's most expensive effort setting in F tier, why Claude Code finds new bugs every time you ask it to review the same code, "delete your website" vs. Mark's own numbers, and the startup whose CI bill went from $230 to $4,300 a month (and says it's the cheapest money they spend).

Play Fake or Real with us: 3 rounds. Comment your score.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Elon never said that
1:01 The Elon quote that never happened
5:19 Medium is S tier? Claude's effort tier list
8:06 Why Claude finds new bugs every time
10:04 Film yourself or stay broke: delete your website?
13:36 Builder's corner: the $4,300 CI bill
16:01 Fake or Real: the score

FROM THIS EPISODE

videos.title: Nvidia's CEO and the Alleged Spy | Broski Talk Ep. 3
videos.description:
US officials believe the CEO of one of the most valuable companies on Earth had a romantic relationship with a Chinese spy. Mark Santos and Simon Dziak go through what the Financial Times reported, what Nvidia and China say back, and why a spy would go after a CEO instead of an engineer. Then the week: a new Claude codename hiding inside someone else's app (and Polymarket's odds it ships this month), a judge who says Claude's "5x or 20x more usage" pitch could be misleading, Apple's official Claude Code plugin, Starlink's Grok Super Bowl ad, Figure's office full of robots, Google's $69 billion SpaceX stake, and the AI backlash debate, where we look up data center water use live.

Real scandal or smear? Comment SCANDAL or SMEAR. And is the AI backlash RIGHT or WRONG?

CHAPTERS
0:00 Real scandal or smear?
0:31 Nvidia's CEO and the alleged Chinese spy
2:43 The next Claude is hiding in someone else's app
4:55 The fine print on your Claude plan
7:12 Lightning round: Apple, Starlink, robots, SpaceX, multiplayer
11:20 Is the AI backlash right? Data centers vs golf courses
